name: Division by zero
description: Flags divisions by zero where they are likely to happen.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a `/` or `%` whose right-hand operand is a compile-time-constant zero (e.g. `x / 0`, `x % 0.0`, `x / (1 - 1)`), since that crashes the script at runtime. Only a divisor built entirely from literals (combined with arithmetic and unary operators) is checked; one that depends on an identifier, a call, `Self`/`Parent`, a member/index access, a cast, or a `new` array is left unflagged rather than guessed at.
